Supreme Court to Hear KG Basin Gas Dispute Mediation

The Supreme Court is set to hear the KG Basin gas dispute, with the Centre raising no objection to former Supreme Court Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai acting as a mediator. The Centre has agreed to Justice Desai's mediation in the dispute.
